quranTranslation.text: And when your Lord proclaimed: If ye give thanks, I will give you more; but if ye are thankless, lo! My punishment is dire.

explanation.bs: „Ako zahvalite… a ako budete nezahvalni“ – كَفَرَ kao suprotnost zahvalnosti.
explanation.en: “If ye give thanks … but if ye are thankless” — كَفَرَ as the opposite of gratitude.

quranTranslation.text: And verily We gave Luqman wisdom, saying: Give thanks unto Allah; and whosoever giveth thanks, he giveth thanks for (the good of) his soul. And whosoever refuseth - Lo! Allah is Absolute, Owner of Praise.

explanation.bs: Ko zahvaljuje, sebi zahvaljuje, a ko je nezahvalan – Allah je neovisan.
explanation.en: Whoever is grateful is grateful for himself; whoever is ungrateful — Allah is Free of need.

quranTranslation.text: Say: Shall I choose for a protecting friend other than Allah, the Originator of the heavens and the earth, Who feedeth and is never fed? Say: I am ordered to be the first to surrender (unto Him). And be not thou (O Muhammad) of the idolaters.

explanation.bs: „I nipošto ne budi od mušrika!“ – Poslanik se odriče svakog druga Allahu.
explanation.en: “And be not thou (O Muhammad) of the idolaters” — the Prophet disowns every partner to Allah.

quranTranslation.text: Wed not idolatresses till they believe; for lo! a believing bondwoman is better than an idolatress though she please you; and give not your daughters in marriage to idolaters till they believe, for lo! a believing slave is better than an idolater though he please you. These invite unto the Fire, and Allah inviteth unto the Garden, and unto forgiveness by His grace, and expoundeth His revelations to mankind that haply they may remember.

explanation.bs: Ne ženite se mušrikama dok ne povjeruju – mušrik je zasebna kategorija u propisima o braku (obim ovog ajeta i njegov odnos prema 5:5 raspravlja se u fikhu).
explanation.en: Do not marry polytheistic women until they believe — the polytheist is a category of its own in the marriage rulings (the ayah's scope and its relation to 5:5 are discussed in fiqh).

quranTranslation.text: When the hypocrites come unto thee (O Muhammad), they say: We bear witness that thou art indeed Allah's messenger. And Allah knoweth that thou art indeed His messenger, and Allah beareth witness that the hypocrites indeed are speaking falsely.

explanation.bs: Svjedoče da je on Allahov Poslanik, a Allah svjedoči da su lažljivci – riječi bez uvjerenja.
explanation.en: They bear witness that he is Allah's Messenger, and Allah bears witness that they are liars — words without conviction.

quranTranslation.text: The hypocrites, both men and women, proceed one from another. They enjoin the wrong, and they forbid the right, and they withhold their hands (from spending for the cause of Allah). They forget Allah, so He hath forgotten them. Lo! the hypocrites, they are the transgressors.

explanation.bs: „Zaista, licemjeri – oni su nepokorni“ – ar-Rāġib ovaj ajet navodi uz nifāq.
explanation.en: “Lo! the hypocrites, they are the transgressors” — the ayah ar-Rāġib cites under nifāq.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! the hypocrites (will be) in the lowest deep of the Fire, and thou wilt find no helper for them;

explanation.bs: Licemjeri će biti na samom dnu vatre – težina skrivenog nevjerstva.
explanation.en: The hypocrites will be in the lowest depth of the Fire — the gravity of hidden disbelief.

quranTranslation.text: And his wife, standing by laughed when We gave her good tidings (of the birth) of Isaac, and, after Isaac, of Jacob.

explanation.bs: Ibrahimova žena, koja je stajala, „se nasmijala“ – ar-Rāġib: od čuđenja, kako pokazuje njeno pitanje u 11:72.
explanation.en: Abraham's wife “laughed” — ar-Rāġib: from wonder, as her question in 11:72 shows.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed,

explanation.bs: Grješnici „su se smijali onima koji vjeruju“ – smijeh kao podsmijeh.
explanation.en: The criminals “used to laugh at those who believed” — laughter as mockery.

quranTranslation.text: Then let them laugh a little: they will weep much, as the reward of what they used to earn.

explanation.bs: „Neka se, dakle, malo smiju, a mnogo će plakati“ – smijeh nasuprot plaču.
explanation.en: “Then let them laugh a little: they will weep much” — laughter against weeping.

quranTranslation.text: And (Solomon) smiled, laughing at her speech, and said: My Lord, arouse me to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and to do good that shall be pleasing unto Thee, and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves.

explanation.bs: „Pa se on nasmiješi (فَتَبَسَّمَ), smijući se (ضَاحِكًا) njenim riječima“ – obje riječi u jednom izrazu; slijedi zahvala Allahu.
explanation.en: “And (Solomon) smiled (فَتَبَسَّمَ), laughing (ضَاحِكًا) at her speech” — both words in one phrase; thanks to Allah follow.

quranTranslation.text: If ye be on a journey and cannot find a scribe, then a pledge in hand (shall suffice). And if one of you entrusteth to another let him who is trusted deliver up that which is entrusted to him (according to the pact between them) and let him observe his duty to Allah his Lord. Hide not testimony. He who hideth it, verily his heart is sinful. Allah is Aware of what ye do.

explanation.bs: „I ne prikrivajte svjedočenje; ko ga prikrije, njegovo je srce grješno“ – prešutjeti ono što se duguje.
explanation.en: “Hide not testimony. He who hideth it, verily his heart is sinful” — withholding what is owed.

quranTranslation.text: Those unto whom We gave the Scripture recognise (this revelation) as they recognise their sons. But lo! a party of them knowingly conceal the truth.

explanation.bs: „A jedna skupina njih, zaista, prikriva istinu, a znaju“ – prešućivanje istine.
explanation.en: “But lo! a party of them knowingly conceal the truth” — withholding the truth.

quranTranslation.text: On that day those who disbelieved and disobeyed the messenger will wish that they were level with the ground, and they can hide no fact from Allah.

explanation.bs: Na Sudnjem danu „neće od Allaha prikriti nijednu riječ“ – ar-Rāġib navodi Ibn Abbasa: mnogobošci će isprva poricati, potom će im udovi svjedočiti, pa će poželjeti da ništa nisu prikrili.
explanation.en: On that Day “they can hide no fact from Allah” — ar-Rāġib quotes Ibn ʿAbbās: the polytheists first deny, then their limbs testify, and they wish they had concealed nothing.

quranTranslation.text: If ye publish your almsgiving, it is well, but if ye hide it and give it to the poor, it will be better for you, and will atone for some of your ill-deeds. Allah is Informed of what ye do.

explanation.bs: „Ako sadake javno dajete, to je lijepo, a ako ih sakrijete i date siromasima, to je za vas bolje“ – sakriti nasuprot pokazati.
explanation.en: “If ye publish your almsgiving, it is well, but if ye hide it and give it to the poor, it will be better for you” — hiding against showing.

quranTranslation.text: Then, after grief, He sent down security for you. As slumber did it overcome a party of you, while (the other) party, who were anxious on their own account, thought wrongly of Allah, the thought of ignorance. They said: Have we any part in the cause? Say (O Muhammad): The cause belongeth wholly to Allah. They hide within themselves (a thought) which they reveal not unto thee, saying: Had we had any part in the cause we should not have been slain here. Say: Even though ye had been in your houses, those appointed to be slain would have gone forth to the places where they were to lie. (All this hath been) in order that Allah might try what is in your breasts and prove what is in your hearts. Allah is Aware of what is hidden in the breasts (of men).

explanation.bs: „Kriju u sebi ono što tebi ne pokazuju“ – sakrivena misao.
explanation.en: “They hide within themselves (a thought) which they reveal not unto thee” — a hidden thought.

quranTranslation.text: Unto Allah (belongeth) whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; and whether ye make known what is in your minds or hide it, Allah will bring you to account for it. He will forgive whom He will and He will punish whom He will. Allah is Able to do all things.

explanation.bs: „Pokažete li ono što je u vama ili ga sakrijete, Allah će vas za to pozvati na račun“ – i skriveno je poznato Allahu.
explanation.en: “…whether ye make known what is in your minds or hide it, Allah will bring you to account for it” — the hidden too is known to Allah.

quranTranslation.text: When the Prophet confided a fact unto one of his wives and when she afterward divulged it and Allah apprised him thereof, he made known (to her) part thereof and passed over part. And when he told it her she said: Who hath told thee? He said: The Knower, the Aware hath told me.

explanation.bs: „Kad je Vjerovjesnik u tajnosti povjerio nešto nekoj od svojih žena“ – tajna povjerena jednome.
explanation.en: “When the Prophet confided a fact unto one of his wives” — a secret entrusted to one person.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Choose not My enemy and your enemy for allies. Do ye give them friendship when they disbelieve in that truth which hath come unto you, driving out the messenger and you because ye believe in Allah, your Lord? If ye have come forth to strive in My way and seeking My good pleasure, (show them not friendship). Do ye show friendship unto them in secret, when I am Best Aware of what ye hide and what ye proclaim? And whosoever doeth it among you, he verily hath strayed from the right way.

explanation.bs: „Vi im potajno iskazujete naklonost, a Ja dobro znam i ono što ste sakrili i ono što ste javno pokazali“ – povjeravanje, sakrivanje, objavljivanje.
explanation.en: “Do ye show friendship unto them in secret, when I am Best Aware of what ye hide and what ye proclaim?” — confiding, concealing, declaring.

quranTranslation.text: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private.

explanation.bs: Nuh: „…javno sam im govorio, i u tajnosti sam im govorio“ – tajno nasuprot javnog.
explanation.en: Noah: “I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private” — secret against open.

quranTranslation.text: What expect they save the like of the days of those who passed away before them? Say: Expect then! I am with you among the expectant.

explanation.bs: „Pa čekaju li oni išta osim dana poput dana onih koji su prije njih prošli? Reci: ‚Pa čekajte, i ja sam s vama među onima koji čekaju!‘“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “What expect they save the like of the days of those who passed away before them? Say: Expect then! I am with you among the expectant” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And wait! Lo! We (too) are waiting.

explanation.bs: „I čekajte, i mi čekamo!“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And wait! Lo! We (too) are waiting” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Of the believers are men who are true to that which they covenanted with Allah. Some of them have paid their vow by death (in battle), and some of them still are waiting; and they have not altered in the least;

explanation.bs: „… neki su od njih svoj zavjet ispunili smrću, a neki još čekaju, i ništa nisu zamijenili“ – čekanje vjernika, bez ikakvog zla.
explanation.en: “Some of them have paid their vow by death (in battle), and some of them still are waiting” — the believers' waiting, with no ill intent.

quranTranslation.text: Women who are divorced shall wait, keeping themselves apart, three (monthly) courses. And it is not lawful for them that they should conceal that which Allah hath created in their wombs if they are believers in Allah and the Last Day. And their husbands would do better to take them back in that case if they desire a reconciliation. And they (women) have rights similar to those (of men) over them in kindness, and men are a degree above them. Allah is Mighty, Wise.

explanation.bs: „Razvedene žene neka čekaju, sustežući se, tri mjesečna perioda“ – čekanje određenog roka; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Women who are divorced shall wait, keeping themselves apart, three (monthly) courses” — waiting out a set term; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to await, to lie in wait

quranTranslation.text: Say: Can ye await for us aught save one of two good things (death or victory in Allah's way)? while we await for you that Allah will afflict you with a doom from Him or at our hands. Await then! Lo! We are awaiting with you.

explanation.bs: „Reci: ‚Čekate li za nas išta drugo osim jednog od dva dobra? A mi čekamo da vas Allah pogodi kaznom …‘“ – čekanje ishoda za drugoga; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Can ye await for us aught save one of two good things … while we await for you that Allah will afflict you with a doom” — waiting for an outcome to befall another; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to await, to lie in wait

quranTranslation.text: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant.

explanation.bs: „Reci: ‚Čekajte, i ja sam s vama među onima koji čekaju!‘“ – odgovor onima koji su rekli da čekaju da njega stigne nesreća (52:30); ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi.
explanation.en: Await, I am awaiting with you — the answer to those who said they waited for misfortune to strike him (52:30); ar-Rāġib cites these words.

gloss.en: to await, to lie in wait

quranTranslation.text: And Allah brought you forth from the wombs of your mothers knowing nothing, and gave you hearing and sight and hearts that haply ye might give thanks.

explanation.bs: „Iz utroba vaših majki Allah vas je izveo dok ništa niste znali, a podario vam je sluh, oči i srca …“ – sluh kao moć i dar; samʿ je u jednini, a abṣār i afʾida u množini.
explanation.en: “And Allah brought you forth from the wombs of your mothers knowing nothing, and gave you hearing and sight and hearts” — hearing as a power and a gift; samʿ is singular, abṣār and afʾida plural.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing.

explanation.bs: „Oni su, doista, od slušanja odstranjeni“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za samʿ kao čin slušanja: šejtani (26:210) su udaljeni od toga da slušaju.
explanation.en: “Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah for samʿ as the act of hearing: the devils (26:210) are kept away from listening.

quranTranslation.text: And We prescribed for them therein: The life for the life, and the eye for the eye, and the nose for the nose, and the ear for the ear, and the tooth for the tooth, and for wounds retaliation. But whoso forgoeth it (in the way of charity) it shall be expiation for him. Whoso judgeth not by that which Allah hath revealed: such are wrong-doers.

explanation.bs: „… da je život za život, oko za oko, nos za nos i uho za uho …“ – uho kao dio tijela, u propisu o odmazdi propisanom sinovima Israilovim.
explanation.en: “The life for the life, and the eye for the eye, and the nose for the nose, and the ear for the ear” — the ear as a part of the body, in the law of retaliation prescribed for the Children of Israel.

quranTranslation.text: Have they not travelled in the land, and have they hearts wherewith to feel and ears wherewith to hear? For indeed it is not the eyes that grow blind, but it is the hearts, which are within the bosoms, that grow blind.

explanation.bs: „… ili uši kojima bi slušali?“ – uši kao organ kojim se čuje; ajet nastavlja da ne slijepe oči, nego srca u grudima.
explanation.en: “… and have they hearts wherewith to feel and ears wherewith to hear?” — ears as the organ one hears with; the ayah goes on: it is not the eyes that grow blind but the hearts within the breasts.

quranTranslation.text: And of them are those who vex the Prophet and say: He is only a hearer. Say: A hearer of good for you, who believeth in Allah and is true to the believers, and a mercy for such of you as believe. Those who vex the messenger of Allah, for them there is a painful doom.

explanation.bs: „… i govore: ‚On je uho.‘ Reci: ‚Uho dobra za vas …‘“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet: ‚uho‘ se kaže za onoga ko mnogo sluša, a Poslanikovo slušanje vama donosi dobro.
explanation.en: “… and say: He is only a hearer. Say: A hearer of good for you” — the Arabic word is udhun, ‘an ear’; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah: ‘ear’ for one who listens much, and the Prophet's listening is to your good.
